description: Different model profiles should preserve Express/Supertest planning decisions, including route integration extension and app wiring deferral.

lockedFields.reason: The repo-native verification command comes from deterministic Jest/Supertest convention detection.
The tested route provides bounded indirect evidence for the service layer, so no target requires a brand-new test file.
The covered route and its indirectly exercised service should be extended for missing edge cases.
Existing Supertest route coverage should be extended rather than replaced with a new unit test.
HTTP route behavior should remain an integration-level recommendation.
Application wiring should stay deferred to route or integration tests.
The app wiring file should not receive a direct generated test recommendation.

unexpectedVariations: different route placement in the plan
